changelog: Anyone can design now. There is no special "designer" role any more — a designer is whoever's role has the "Design jobs" permission ticked on the Roles screen.
So when the design staff are busy and the owner or a manager does a job, their name appears in the designer list, the job is recorded against them, and it counts in their month.

Tick or untick the permission for a role and those people appear or disappear everywhere designers are listed — the assign dropdown, the shared board, the dashboard and the reports. Nothing else to change.
Assigning a job now counts the same as accepting one, so work handed out by a manager is counted too.
The monthly design report keeps anyone who has ever done design work, so a person whose role changes later does not vanish from last month's figures.
Manager now has design access out of the box, alongside Super Admin and Designer.
